_comment: Human-confirmed readout outcomes. This is the store the review sweep was designed around: build_readout_results.py renders these as precise day-of reactions (upgrading the auto-logged window move), build_guided_readouts.py marks the guided row Reported, and build_drug_pages.py stops listing the event as upcoming. Every entry needs a primary source URL; prices are Polygon adjusted closes. Facts only.

reported.summary: Phase 3 INTerpath-001 (n=1,137): intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) + Keytruda met the primary endpoint of recurrence-free survival AND the key secondary of distant metastasis-free survival vs Keytruda alone in completely resected stage IIB-IV cutaneous melanoma; statistically significant and clinically meaningful on both, no new safety signals. First positive Phase 3 readout for an individualized neoantigen therapy and for an mRNA-based cancer therapy. OS follow-up continues.
reported.note: Dual-listed event: Merck co-develops with Moderna (see MRNA row, same source).

reported.summary: Phase 3 LUCIDITY in post-bariatric hypoglycemia (n=78, RYGB) met the FDA-agreed primary endpoint: 55% reduction in the composite rate of Level 2 and Level 3 hypoglycemic events vs placebo (p=0.000003). All secondary endpoints met (Level 2 by SMBG, Level 2 by CGM, Level 3 events). No serious adverse events related to treatment; most common AEs diarrhea and injection-site reactions. NDA planned by end of 2026; avexitide holds Breakthrough Therapy and Orphan Drug designations.
reported.note: Miner postmortem: EDGAR pass never saw it (guidance predates the 45-day scan window); CT.gov pass excluded NCT06747468 because its estimated PCD (2026-03) was ~140 days overdue, outside the 120-day OVERDUE_DAYS window -- widened to 180 same day. Prices deliberately absent at write time (market open); build self-heals from Polygon.

reported.summary: Phase 2 in moderate-to-severe vasomotor symptoms (menopause) met the primary endpoint: mean reduction of 8.8 moderate/severe hot flashes/day at Week 4 vs 3.5 on placebo (placebo-adjusted -5.3, statistically significant), n=92; severity -1.4 vs -0.3; no elevated liver enzymes or bilirubin reported in the treated arm.
reported.note: Reported early in the company-guided Q3 2026 window.

reported.summary: Phase 3 LEVEL (NCT05983250) in PH-HFpEF did not meet its primary endpoint: patients walked 3.5 metres further than placebo in six minutes at Week 12 (p=0.63), a difference small enough to be chance; the key secondary (KCCQ-TSS, 0.1 points) was also not met. A prespecified subgroup with baseline 6MWD under 333 m improved 26.3 m (nominal p=0.0112) and NT-proBNP fell 49% versus placebo (nominal p<0.0001), but the company states: 'Nominal p-values are not adjusted for multiplicity and these analyses do not establish efficacy.' Tenax intends to request a Type C meeting with FDA. Full results were a Late-Breaking Clinical Science presentation at ESC Congress 2026 (Munich). LEVEL-2, a separate Phase 3 of the same drug, continues enrolling into 2027.
reported.note: Caught 24 days late by the 09-02e audit; the CT.gov readout watcher now flags the primary-completion-ACTUAL signature this row showed.

reported.summary: Phase 2 ZEPHYR met its primary endpoint: statistically significant improvement in PANSS total score versus placebo at Week 5 on the 210/3 mg BID dose in acute schizophrenia. Generally well tolerated; no serious or drug-related severe adverse events reported.
reported.note: Caught 38 days late by the 09-02e audit.
